ui_bugs.issue: /invoices?pageSize=50&page=99 rendered a page that has NEITHER the standard empty-state banner ('Δεν βρέθηκαν παραστατικά') NOR the ListPagination bar (pagination-range = ''). Expected behaviour (per review request and consistent with /projects, /customers, /quotes) is that page is clamped to the last populated page with real rows visible + pagination. listInvoices does clamp `page` server-side (lines 138-139), but the surrounding invoices/page.tsx apparently short-circuits to a bare state when the currently-active period filter yields 0 rows for that (clamped) page, or the ListPagination is only rendered when rows>0. Repro: hit /invoices?pageSize=50&page=99 on demo org — observed range='' empty-state hidden. Note: /quotes?page=999 correctly clamps and shows '1–1 από 1 προσφορές', so the shared component works; the defect is invoices-specific.

rca_of_the_issue: /invoices out-of-range clamp RCA: listInvoices (lib/services/invoices.ts:138-139) clamps `page = Math.min(Math.max(1, opts.page ?? 1), Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize)))` and returns `{rows, total, page, pages}`. However invoices/page.tsx apparently checks `rows.length === 0` (or similar) to short-circuit into a hidden 'no results in period' branch even when total>0 for that (now-clamped) page. The URL /invoices?pageSize=50&page=99 on demo org (33 invoices, default fiscal-quarter filter narrows further) produced pagination-range='' AND the localized empty-state text was NOT visible either — a third code path with no user actionable UI. Fix: in invoices/page.tsx use the returned `paged.page` from listInvoices as the source of truth (not `sp.page`) and always render ListPagination when total>0, mirroring app/(app)/customers/page.tsx and app/(app)/quotes/page.tsx which correctly clamp.
